program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((sevens (find-color g 7))
                  (col (second (car sevens)))
                  (rbot (max-of first sevens)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((d (- rbot r))
                            (dist (abs (- c col))))
                        (if (and (>= d 0) (<= dist d))
                            (if (zero? (remainder dist 2)) 7 8)
                            0)))))))
